set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p canonical/astra_runtime/tmp canonical/astra_runtime/evidence
apt-cache policy qrencode
apt-cache show qrencode > /tmp/qrencode.show
grep '^SHA256:' /tmp/qrencode.show | head -n1
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qrencode >/tmp/qrencode.install.log
qrencode -o canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PROJECT_BRAIN_QR.png 'PROJECT BRAIN'
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PROJECT_BRAIN_QR.png")
raw=p.read_bytes()
assert raw.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")
v=subprocess.check_output(["dpkg-query","-W","-f=${Version}","qrencode"],text=True).strip()
show=pathlib.Path("/tmp/qrencode.show").read_text()
sha=next(x.split(":",1)[1].strip() for x in show.splitlines() if x.startswith("SHA256:"))
out={"schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_APT_SUPPLIER_PROBE_V1","package":"qrencode","version":v,
     "archive_sha256":sha,"output_path":str(p),"output_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
     "output_bytes":len(raw),"effect_verified":"PNG_SIGNATURE_AND_NONEMPTY"}
pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/ASTRA-QR-APT-SUPPLIER-PROBE-001__RESULT.json").write_text(
 json.dumps(out,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print("APT_QR_SUPPLIER_VERIFIED",json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
